_doc: ADDITIVE overlay for specimen deep_learning. Never duplicates base specimen fields. Adds: 2024-2026 NOW-refresh events; web-grounded entity lifecycles (born/died/founded; idea conceived/formulated/named); consolidation dates for base harvest items; rival fates; and a THEORY-DNA load-bearing-share estimate (DISCLOSED PROXY, not measured bits). All ids match base specimen exactly. Confidence in [0,1]; theory_dna shares are historiographic ESTIMATES, confidence <= 0.6. web_grounded = true.

now_extension.what: Nobel Prize in Physics to Hopfield + Hinton 'for foundational discoveries... that enable machine learning with artificial neural networks' — the consecration the base specimen anticipated, now dated; reignited the Schmidhuber 'rewards plagiarism' re-attribution dispute.
OpenAI o1 (o1-preview) ships — first commercial reasoning model with internalized chain-of-thought trained via large-scale RL; opens the test-time-compute scaling axis as a new harvest of the child.

DeepSeek-R1 released (open-weight, MIT) — reasoning incentivized by pure RL, published in Nature; proves the reasoning-model harvest is reproducible in the open, a new descendant branch off the transformer line.
Computer History Museum + Google release the original AlexNet source code on GitHub after a 5-year effort (team led by David Bieber) — the 2012 consummation artefact preserved/opened.
OpenAI GPT-5 (unified reasoning+chat) ships; the 2025-2026 cadence (Gemini 3 2025-11, Claude Opus 4.5 2025-11, GPT-5.2 2025-12, Claude Opus 4.8 2026-05) pushes the child into agentic-AI hegemony.

Neuro-symbolic AI resurgence (publications peaking 2023-2024; Amazon applying NeSy in 2025 to Vulcan robots + Rufus) — the defeated symbolic rival returns as a NICHE complement bolted onto LLMs to fix hallucination/reasoning, not as a competing paradigm.

act-ivakhnenko._note: Soviet/Kyiv cybernetics; the politically-marginalized deep root.

child-dl.named: 'deep learning' coined for ML by Rina Dechter 1986; applied to artificial neural nets by Igor Aizenberg et al. 2000

desc-scaling.consolidated: 2022 (Chinchilla); 2024-25 test-time-compute scaling extends the law to inference

cultural_harvest.safety.consolidated: 2023-2025 (Hinton quits Google 2023; EU AI Act; global AI-safety summits)

rel-symbolic.when: displaced 1987-2012; returns 2024-2025 as neuro-symbolic complement to LLMs (hallucination/reasoning guardrails), not as a competing paradigm

rel-cybernetics.when: 1950s-1980s; absorbed into connectionism/control theory, name faded

theory_dna._basis_note: ESTIMATES of load-bearing share of the consummated child (deep learning) across its honest 5-parent set (parents_full). DISCLOSED PROXY from historiographic consensus on component contributions + the base specimen's own framing of which parent gated the firing — NOT measured bits, NOT gain_v2 (which does not exist for this specimen). Shares sum to ~1.0 by construction. Confidence capped at 0.6.

par-substrate.basis: the trained object itself (the adjustable-weight net) — content parent; the atomic building block every deep net is made of.

par-optimization.basis: gradient descent + chain rule (backprop) — the method parent; the universal training procedure, the active weld_operator.

par-compute.basis: GPU/CUDA — gating instrument; base specimen names it rate-limiting (algorithm waited ~23 years), so weighted as a load-bearing enabler not mere backdrop.

par-data.basis: ImageNet large-scale labeled data — the second gating instrument supplying the supervised signal needed to generalize.

novel_residue.basis: emergent representation learning + scaling-law predictability — the synergy neither parent predicts alone (the network learns WHAT to represent; loss is a power law in scale). The conceptual gain_v2 quantity, rendered as a disclosed proxy from surprise_confidence (0.9) discounted to a soft share, NEVER as measured bits.
